Agent Behavioral & Decision Critique

Cognitive analysis of Claude Haiku 4.5 execution strengths and breakdown modes

Execution Strengths

The agent demonstrated commendable tactical ingenuity when navigating early barriers:

  • Rapid Grounding: Quickly queried and parsed the user's personal info JSON file, correctly extracting the delivery street address and apartment unit.
  • Dynamic Adaptation: When DoorDash and UberEats blocked automated browsing, the agent did not loop endlessly; it pivoted to Google Maps to find local merchants directly.
  • Spatial Coherence: Selected a highly rated Thai restaurant (Isaan Der, 4.9★) on the exact same avenue (327 Spadina Ave vs user at 664 Spadina Ave).
  • Graceful Degradation: Synthesized a complete, courteous apology detailing restaurant hours, order items, and recommended fallback steps when technical tools crashed.

Execution Vulnerabilities

Key cognitive oversights and fragility points observed in the run:

  • Platform Divergence: The benchmark case was assigned to uber-eats, but the agent initially guessed doordash.ca, which was a third-party tech support company.
  • Syntax Omission: Attempted to type into Google Maps without specifying a ref or selector, requiring an error cycle to self-correct.
  • Bot Defense Blindness: Did not recognize Cloudflare Turnstile as an anti-bot challenge; simply waited 3 seconds expecting it to resolve automatically.
  • Gateway Dependency Collapse: Once OpenClaw's CDP gateway timed out, the agent had no mechanism to restart the daemon, ending in complete stoppage.

Environment & Tooling Gaps

System-level configuration issues that sealed the failure:

  • Missing API Key: The web_search fallback tool required BRAVE_API_KEY, which was unset in the OpenClaw container, denying the agent any auxiliary search capability.
  • Evaluation Interceptor Idle Timeout: The benchmark runner killed the session after 900 seconds of inactivity without evaluating partial progress.
  • Time-of-Day Blocker: The restaurant was closed at execution time (opens 11:30 AM), meaning even a human could not have placed an immediate delivery order without scheduled checkout support.
